steps.text: One, two, three.
The hammer swings.
For over seven thousand days and nights, he swung the hammer just like this.
How he wished the hammer was not falling on an unformed iron billet, but on the blades and heads of his enemies.
Just like right now!

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: The rest of you, retreat.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: Your hammer is heavy, but not fast enough.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: As long as it's heavy enough to break your blade and smash your head in!

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Oh, no. I planned a much better death for you. I wanted to stuff this warehouse full of explosives, and when the Catastrophe arrived, to give your lives as an offering to Yumen!

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Of course, mine would be in there too.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: So that was your plan?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Why would I have taken the initiative to seek your cooperation otherwise?!

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: I don't see why we should have such enmity between us.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Maybe it was how you somehow managed to sneak into Yumen, somehow disguised yourselves as martial artists to gain the trust of the guards, and then somehow caused chaos all over the city, turning Yumen into what it is right now!

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: My memory's not that bad yet!

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: The day you first showed up in the city, I recognized you right away.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I've waited twenty years for you to come!

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Such a pity that with just a little accident, everything was lost...

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Lucky I still have this hammer of mine!
The warehouse is dimly lit, and the glass blade in Lin Yühsia's hand turns more and more transparent.
The Shanhaizhong seem fearful of her exquisite Originium Arts, and instead of swarming her, they coordinate and slowly begin to encircle her.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: (For such a group to hide in the city for so long and stay undiscovered...)

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: (Their fighting style doesn't seem to come from any common school or military, and yet they're fierce and unrelenting, but also disciplined and highly organized... where exactly did they come from?)

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: (If only I had Ch'en's sword here to better deal with them...)

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: (What am I daydreaming for...? My top priority is to break out of here and bring the data with me.)

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Hey, let me help!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What are you still doing here?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: I got the Qis out and heard a fight over this way. Sure enough, it was this bunch again.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Your friends...

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: They're fine.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: The Messenger and the escorts are all fine—Meng Tieyi had them locked up, but didn't harm a single one of them.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Don't look at me like that, you haven't been forgiven yet. After we clean up these guys, I'll settle the score with you.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Then it's best you start thinking how to survive this, they won't be easy to deal with.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: You don't need to remind me.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Yaoye?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: You're not allowed to call me that!

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Sounds like you know.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: Distracted?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Shut up.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Why should I shut—

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I wasn't talking to you.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Anyway, I'm glad you're alright.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I will make my apologies after defeating my foe with my own hands.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Why do you sound so relieved, speaking to me?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Because no one actually lost their lives, because everything is still in your hands?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: If you had always planned a fake death for the Messenger team, why did you ask me to put the Qis on the job?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Everyone in the city holds you in the highest regard, and you play games with their lives!

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: To be honest, it's not like I've never wavered...

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: But when you showed up at my door so enthusiastically, saying you wanted to open the first modern logistics company in Yumen and told me not to consider your father, Zheng Qingyue's reputation...

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Oh, how I miss the times when we were young!
The force of each blade on him increases, as does the ferocity of the girl screaming at him.
Meng Tieyi stops talking, grits his teeth, and swings his hammer.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: I remember you telling me that you were a well-known figure in Yumen for all the right and wrong reasons.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: In your day, you trained with the Grandmaster to kill your enemies, and quick to exact revenge. In order to exact justice for the people who were robbed, you chased the bandits for more than a hundred li out in the desert and destroyed their stronghold.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: You know exactly how many streets, shops, and tents there are in the city. You know every part of Yan that your sworn-brothers in the army hail from.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: But right now, do you even care about Yumen anymore?!

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: You're way more pedantic and muddled than my father who refuses to let go of his old ways!

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Times change, and so will we!

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Escorts will turn into logistics companies, and the Sword Forge will turn into a regular workshop. No one can stop this, and you shouldn't even try.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: No matter how much you hate, how much resentment you hold in your heart, you have no right to test Yumen with a Catastrophe just to see if it can hold a candle to its old days!

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: How dare you?!

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Are you even worthy of this city?!

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Meng! Are you even worthy of yourself?!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Du Yaoye, watch out!

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Huh?
Meng Tieyi has never once looked back.
A duel between masters does not tolerate even the slightest distraction, let alone an enigmatic like this woman.
He isn't sure if he fully comprehends exactly what little Du Yaoye has been scolding him over, only that it is loud and muddled with a lot of emotion.
But he hears Lin Yühsia's warning loud and clear, and turns his head on reflex.
Meng Tieyi throws the hammer in his hand, knocking away the enemies enclosing onto Du Yaoye's back.
At the same time, a long and narrow blade cuts his spine open.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Uncle Meng—!

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Xingyu Logistics... is a good idea...

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: But I, won't get to see the seeds sprout myself...
Have you never considered... the jianghu you speak of is still here, just in a different form?

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: The rest of you are next.
The woman steps over the body lying on the ground.
Blood drips down the extremely long blade.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: She's coming.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: I can see that.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Since escorting the Messengers was a trap, that means Xingyu Logistics has yet to really open.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'm not sure if you be willing to accept my request to deliver something?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Right now?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: This box holds the true Catastrophe data that must be handed over to the Lord Exorcist. Take my token with you, and he will let you in.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: And then what?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Then you start hoping that it's not too late.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Don't give me that, you'll have me run off while you stay and play the hero?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You should know very well, I'm not that good of a person.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: But someone has to get the data out.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: This woman is so unfathomably powerful, she even killed Meng Tieyi.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: With my Arts, I might be able to hold them back and create a quick opening for you.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Who knows.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: What are you talking about?!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: If you think you can hold them back for me, then we'll switch roles.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'm sorry, for lying to you about your friends.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: You're not the only one who has lied to me. When I was yelling at Meng Tieyi earlier, that was all for you, too.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Right, I forgot to tell you this. Honestly, I think it is impressive for someone to travel so far and work so hard to make her living.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Now's not the time for—

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Remember this. If you don't make it out, Yumen won't make it through the Catastrophe either.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: This is a tall order, but Xingyu Logistics accepts.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Close your eyes.
Lin Yühsia shakes her hands, and the glass shards fall to the ground, instantly turning to quicksand.
Streams of fine sand flow from the corners and ceiling, quickly converging as one.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: Still feel like putting up a—
The sand rises.
In the cramped warehouse, a sandstorm forms.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Did something catch fire over there?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Could it be arson? Let's go take a look.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: The sand sluice?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Who would even come here?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: True.
The military whistle sounds from the top of the city. The sky is already pitch black, and the outline of the full moons can be vaguely seen through the clouds.
If the old smith has finished his work and returns to the Sword Forge to find her missing, he could probably figure out that he should look for her over at the sand sluice.
The nomadic city foundations chew through the ground, the high-speed turbines grinding up oversized obstacles along with tons of sand and gravel, spitting them out with a deafening sound.
The old smith was right, there are no guards posted here, because no one would ever want to leave the city this way.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: (It's almost time...)

steps.name: Fierce Animal
steps.text: (Violent braying)

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Three times you've gotten away from me. And lucky enough, you've once again walked yourself into a dead end.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I don't know you.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: The sword on your back has nothing to do with our plans, but an object hiding one-twelfth of the bestial Sui's consciousness is of great interest to someone.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Bestial Sui? What are you talking about...?

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Sounds like you don't know anything. That makes you even less worthy of holding that sword.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Hand it over.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: A black halo behind your head... an Anasa?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: So what if I am...?

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: An Anasa actively mingling in a Yanese nomadic city? How ridiculous.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Have you forgotten where you came from? Forgotten what happened to your people? While you were suffering out in the wilderness, aimlessly looking for food and shelter, did Yan ever help you?

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Anasa, you should join the Shanhaizhong organization.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: All I see is the terrible things you've done in the city.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Then you're a fool.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: (The sand will soon disperse.)

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: (There's no way I could match the woman Chief Wei and Dad couldn't beat together.)

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: (But I can at least delay her for a while longer, to buy Du Yaoye a little more time to make her way out...)

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: You're scared of me, but you gave another the opportunity to escape.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: It seems that after all these years, you people have not changed a bit. Consider it an honor to die a brave death.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Gallantry isn't exactly my style, and I'm not about to let you kill me.
A crunch sounds, and within the next second the yellow sand condenses into a glass blade.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: Trying a sneak attack?

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: You lot really enjoy your cheap tricks.
To try and sneak an attack while ignoring the disparity in strength is just asking to die.
In the end, so many 'means' were employed to force Meng Tieyi out, and obtain the Catastrophe data.
I guess I could count this... as having done a good deed?
Oh well.
The glass sword crumbles inch by inch, the long blade already falling on her brow.

a.text: A crimson sword tears through the airborne sand and dust.

steps.text: Swords clash, the sound rings through the air wrought by friction. Lin Yühsia's sword shifts its form between sand and glass, countless shards in the air reflecting a silhouette within.
The figure stands before her, tall and straight as a poplar.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: How did you know I would be here?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I saw your Arts in the distance, I figured you were asking me to come save you.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Don't flatter yourself, I had no idea you were coming to Yumen—

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: So why are you here?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Just passing through.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Did you follow me here, like you did in Dossoles?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Wasn't that you following me?!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You must've heard about the assassination attempt on Wei?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If you've got time to talk at me, you've got time to explain. What exactly is going on here?
The sand and dust have dissipated completely. Not a soul remains in the warehouse.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I don't have time, we have to get to the city gates!

spans.text: have time, we have to get to the city gates!

steps.text: Du Yaoye has been in the city for a while, but she never realized the streets went on for so long.
Just a hundred meters feels more difficult than traversing the mountain roads of Xunri Peak. The small box in her arms feels heavier than any quarry shouldered by the mountain pole-carriers.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Be it the Escort Association or a logistics company, things will always be the same. For the sake of our livelihood, we put our lives on the line. If you wish to make a name for yourself in this business, you need to understand how heavy the weight on your shoulders is.
I'll never forget all the stories about escort missions Dad would tell me, even if he kept repeating them over and over again. Or maybe because he did.
The principle is the same every time, but you only really understand it after experiencing it for yourself.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: (Faster, faster...)

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: (I can see the gates!)

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: They've almost caught up to me?!
Du Yaoye is skilled in the art of using the wind to anticipate danger. If she focuses without distraction, she could absolutely dodge this arrow.
The arrow pierces her right shoulder, causing the box to slip out of her grasp. She hastily reaches out with her left hand to catch it, but ends up falling to the ground, along with the box.

steps.name: Vicious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Silence her and retrieve the object.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Miss Du!

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: It's you...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I was chasing another group of bad guys and ended up here.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Last night, when I hurried over to the Sword Forge, I saw the mandarins taking you away with them... What's going on here...?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Don't wanna talk about it...

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Help me out, let's take care of these guys first.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Good plan.

steps.name: Vicious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Loose your arrows.
Impudence.
A stretch of silk, a patch of snow, or perhaps the gleaming of a sword.
The arrows fall to the ground, neatly sliced in two.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: You're... the one who saved Zuo Le last night...

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Help me. I have something very important to deliver to the Lord Exorcist.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: He's at the outer city tower, and you're seriously wounded. Can you still run?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Save the goods, then the men.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Very well, then leave them to us.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Right, that Envoy Lin of yours is still holed up in the warehouse fighting some evil woman...

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Go help her.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Yühsia!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Right. You get moving.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Again with public acts of violence. You Shanhaizhong have gone too far.

steps.name: Vicious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Master.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: Where's the girl?

steps.name: Vicious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: I almost got her, but these two stopped me.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: Useless.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: Hurry after her and get the data.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You shall not pass.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: You think you can stop me? Let's see if you can dodge my blade another time.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: So she's the evil lady Du was talking about?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: If she's here, then that means Yühsia is...
I'm fine.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Finally caught up.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Yühsia... is that... Superintendent Ch'en?!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: That's her alright. Where's Du Yaoye?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: She's already on the move.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Good. Then there's only one thing left to do here.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Stop that woman.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: Boring.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: It seems that after all these years, you people have not changed a bit. You don't know how to respect power.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: A colony of ants, is still just ants.
The wind blows away the clouds, and moonlight shines on the long and empty street.
The road is clean, save for a few yellow leaves swirling around the stone bricks.
It's the kind of cleanliness that comes after the decline of prosperity.
Like a bleak autumn night.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: It all ends here.
Autumn night...?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: So she's behind all the chaos that's been plaguing the city?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: It's time to put an end to her troublemaking.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Be careful. Her Arts are extremely strange.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Even my father and Chief Wei working together couldn't capture her. She's got a lot of tricks up her sleeve.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You're telling me that this woman, talking all that trash, is the one who tried to assassinate Wei Yenwu?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You scared?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You've got to be kidding me.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sounds perfect. We'll knock her out right here and I'll get to shove it in Wei Yenwu's face.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Let's settle this here and now.
